Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2006 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
SCISSORS, MICROLARYNGEAL SURGERY 



CO 



>> 

Q> 
CD 

I- 
=> 

CO 

to 
o 

■%- 

■a 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for scissors used in microlaryngeal ENT 

surgery. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 

2.1 A deviation of ± 2*5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

3. Materia] — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 40Crl3 of IS : 6603-1972 ' Specification for 
stainless steel bars and flats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The scissors shall be symmetrical and well balanced. 

4.2 The scissors shall be free from scale, pits, burrs, tool marks and other surface defects. 

4.3 The moving blade shall open and close without stiffness and shall have a slight cross-over 
action to give a continuous pinch. There shall be no play at the joint, 

4.4 The scissors shall be dull matt finished and passivated. 

4.5 All the edges shall be even. The edges shall be rounded except the cutting edges, which shall 
be sharp and shall not have any feather. 

5. Heat Treatment — The scissors shall be hardened and tempered to 540 to 600 HV. 

6. Tests 

6.1 Performance — The scissors shall cut, teased-out cotton wool, fine hairs and latex rubber accu- 
rately and clearly from pinch to tip. 

6.2 Flexibility Test —The flexibility shall be tested in the following manner. 

6.2.1 A force of moderate degree shall be applied by the fingers to the shank attempting to bend 
the shank on width. This shall be repeated at several points along the shank. The test shall then 
be repeated in a plane at right angles to the first on completion of the test, the shank shall not have 
acquired permanent set. 

6.3 Corrosion Resistance — The scissors shall satisfy the boiling and autoclaving test as in IS : 7531- 
1975 ' Method of boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical 
instruments \ 

7. Marking —The scissors shall be marked with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name, initials or recognized trade-mark; and 

b) The country of manufacture. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The scissors shall be wrapped in moisture-proof paper or packed in polyethylene bag 
avoiding contact with one another- They may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser 
and the supplier. 



Adopted 28 June 1978 



October 1978, ISI
